lead: A new `Core` class in a private module declares `pub(crate) const CLASS`, not `pub`.
body: `conventions.md`'s worked example is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/json.rs`, a `pub mod`, so copying its `pub const CLASS` into a private `mod` warns `unreachable pub item`, which the workspace lint policy makes a `verify.py` failure. Every private domain module (`env.rs`, `cap.rs`, `out.rs`) spells `CLASS` and `address` `pub(crate)`.
